event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Off Pulau Cula, Indonesia, in the eastbound lane of the TSS in the SS. Indonesia 01° 05.23' N 103° 35.20' E

sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2023
sources.text: While underway, the master reported to Singapore VTIS West that three perpetrators were sighted in the steering gear room. The perpetrators were armed with knives. The master sounded the alarm and mustered the crew. A search was conducted on board the ship by the crew, with no further sightings of the perpetrators. The crew was safe and nothing was reported stolen. No further assistance was required. Safety navigational broadcast was initiated.
